title: A gentler ending changes the summary
hook: Two stated cases: explore the peak-end summary versus time-integrated discomfort.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the peak-end summary versus time-integrated discomfort affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Memory, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the peak-end summary versus time-integrated discomfort in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy memory rule averages peak 8 and end 6. The actual experience has mean 5 and duration 10. What is the memory-rule score?
